test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

I am much taller __than I was a year ago__.

options.text: that I were a year ago
as I was the year before

solution:
The correct answer is No substitution

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**'T****ha**n' is a conjunction used to two comparable sentence/phrase.

 
 
• 
 
**Ex**: She is smarter ***than ***her sister.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
So, **than **is the correct conjunction here in the sentence.

 
 
• 
 
**I **is a singular noun, hence, need a singular verb.

 
 
• 
 
So, **Was **is the correct helping verb.

 
 
• 
 
Thus, the given sentence is correct.​
